papers.title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion (Uno)
papers.authors: Sahoo et al. (Institute of Foundation Models)
papers.what: Splits a language model into autoregressive weights that define the distribution and lightweight diffusion weights that propose several tokens at once, so parallel decoding preserves the base model exactly with no draft model, giving up to 3x speedup and an 8B model that beats the 26B DiffusionGemma and Mercury 2 on tool use, coding and long-context reasoning.
papers.builds_on: DDPM (Ho 2020, GX7WR7KA); Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM); SPRINT (Biju 2025, BZKDNHD6)

papers.title: FlowBalance: Verifier-Grounded Self-Improvement from On-Policy Reasoning Experience
papers.what: Learns a normalised distribution over complete responses, keeping a terminal verifier as ground truth while a frozen privileged view of the same policy supplies a trajectory-level self-guidance score, which beats FlowRL on Qwen3-4B and 8B, avoids response-length collapse, and keeps higher correct-strategy diversity on a controlled AIME24 diagnostic.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); Chain-of-Thought (Wei 2023, HBLPTRMY); Latent-GRPO (2026, U4ZPM5DN)

papers.title: One Symptom, Three Levers: A Critical Review of On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.what: Reviews on-policy self-distillation with no new experiments, argues that one failure mode dominates the field, the progressive narrowing of the reasoning paths a model can produce, and organises the literature around three levers that govern it: how tokens are weighted, what the teacher is shown, and how guidance decays over training.

papers.title: SMILE: Self-Explainable Multimodal Information Bottleneck for Medical Diagnosis
papers.authors: Yang, Schmatz, Ma, Choi, Jenssen, Yu
papers.what: Puts multimodal medical diagnosis inside the information bottleneck framework and optimises prediction and per-modality explanation in one objective, using a matrix-based Renyi entropy functional instead of a variational bound, so the model reports which elements of which modality carried the decision rather than attributing after the fact.
papers.builds_on: UNI (Chen 2023, 6T29JLTN); Concept Bottleneck Models (Koh 2020, TUIUJY92); SHAP (Lundberg 2017, 46WR27KQ)
